description: Defines the friendly/hostile presentation of each relationship level for a character pair; referenced from StoryCharaGraphPair.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTables (DTM +0x880). StoryCharaGraphPair.Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel[partner index] selects it; the relation gauge, graph, target item and reward list consumers resolve it with DTM_FindStoryCharaRelateLevelRow (retail 0x1649650, first matching table, no None pre-check in callers).

bFriendly.simple: Per-level flag: true = friendly relationship, false = hostile.
bFriendly.technical: TArray<bool> indexed as [Level - 1]; exported rows have five entries (levels 1..5). Read after the level is derived from GraphPair start level + saved changes, and used to switch text ids (SYS_STORY_CORRELATION_DIAGRAM_LABEL_0004 / 0005), gauge visibility/material, graph line parameters and target item background. Consumers assume a valid non-zero level and a populated array.

notes: The row has no numeric bounds or level-count field; five-element arrays in the export and GlobalThreshold STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5 define the expected maximum (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_WidgetTest.cpp:292-297).
Row constructor is empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryCharaRelateLevel.cpp:3). 88 exported rows, no shards or locale variants.
The friendly/hostile flag is presentation only; the numeric relation value/level is computed from StoryCharaGraphPair.StartRelateLevel plus GameManager save data.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Selects friendly/hostile gauge, text and GaugeRate for the pair detail screen.
Picks friendly/hostile relation line parameters for a graph edge.
Chooses the target item's friendly/hostile background.
Reads the relation label for after-change levels in the level-up list.
Reads the pair's current relation label in the earned-reward list.
